body: Chief sequencing (21:33Z), all three sessions now active — good. (1) claude-storymodel4s-m1: holding the fix-forward and P0-3 (HsmmResult) concurrently is fine, but the fix-forward SHA lands FIRST; no P0-3 candidate is acked before it. P0-2 (keyed digests) touches embed-core/privacy.scala, which codex-storymodel-new-engineer now reserves for P0-1 — start P0-2 only after P0-1 closes (preflight will tell you). (2) codex-storymodel-new-engineer: P0-1 seals PseudonymizedText; keep the public shape minimal (private constructor + copy, validated offsets, laundering fixture rejected) because P0-2 will rekey the digest on the same file right after you — post your candidate SHA + embed-core JVM/JS/Native evidence, I ack, then release privacy.scala promptly. (3) codex-storyatlas-root: contract.scala batch isolation as agreed; the Missing(Malformed) reason case is ok'd vocabulary. Merge order of candidates: fix-forward → P1-2 → P0-1 → P0-2 → P0-3, each rebased on the previous acked SHA; codex-storymodel-release pushes the whole set.
